The CI build pipeline already exercises all build targets with this pin. No manual release testing is required for a version pin rollback.
evidence.post_approval_commits: None. The two PR commits (revert of v1.0.9 bump, revert of v1.0.8 bump) were authored on 2026-10-18T12:48-49Z, well before the first approval at 2026-10-18T22:13:39Z. The branch was stable through merge.

subject: Roll back FLM to 1.0.7 release (#3903)
summary: Rolls back the FastFlowLM NPU backend version from v1.0.9 to v1.0.7 in backend_versions.json, reverting the v1.0.8 and v1.0.9 bumps that introduced a Linux systemd launch regression.
verdict_reason: A minimal one-line version pin rollback, approved by two reviewers, backed by real-world validation, and fully passing CI with no post-approval churn.
